rules.description: Review source-linked incoming inventory and exported hold evidence; never execute quarantine or material release.

provenance.note: Official quality references ground the office process; WMS quarantine-order limitations are retained.

rules.description: Join tests, documents and nonconformance evidence for a quality review.

provenance.note: Workflow concepts only; actual numeric criteria and sample size are fictional.

rules.description: Keep normalized physical hold separate from specimen quantity; never add overlapping blocking transactions.

provenance.note: Fictional hold normalization is explicit and does not reconstruct ERP inventory accounting.

rules.description: Strict finite typed bounded tables; identical primary rows collapse with an exception, contradictory IDs reject, unknown text is data.

provenance.note: Complete shape, ranges, duplicate semantics and early rejected-result contract are in HOW_TO.

rules.description: Select exactly one applicable requirement per item/test on receipt date; bound as-of evidence and calendar-day review age.

provenance.note: Explicit dates with inclusive validity, not a sourced ERP version-selection engine.

rules.description: Preserve specimen identity, validate acyclic linear retest chains and supersede only through fully approved eligible links.

provenance.note: Passing replacement without approval cannot erase failure; exact chain rules are fictional.

rules.description: Compare active decimal observations against inclusive limits, counting distinct specimens and retaining failures/gaps.

provenance.note: Completeness checks, not lot acceptance or statistical certification.

rules.description: Require matching valid certificate metadata through as_of when configured; absent/expired/unknown evidence does not pass.

provenance.note: Metadata presence only, no authenticity/OCR/CoA generation claim.

rules.description: Open nonconformance or active failed result routes to nonconformance review; retain concurrent evidence gaps.

provenance.note: Review routing only; no resolution, approval or release action.

rules.description: Unknown master/reference, unexpected tests, missing requirements/hold or future evidence create visible unresolved work.

provenance.note: No invented IDs, test criteria, zero holds or implied pass.

rules.description: Sort review category, age descending and lot ID; reconcile all lot quantities and close a review-required, never production-authorized packet.

provenance.note: Review queue and totals are complete local report artifacts; no actual material disposition.

steps.title: Inventory the mock exports
steps.procedure: Record the actual named table counts and explicit as-of policy.

steps.title: Validate source records
steps.procedure: Validate exact schemas, finite values, ID duplicates, physical scope and bounded retest relationships; reject contradictions before a packet.

steps.title: Match each lot to context
steps.procedure: Match item/specification versions, normalized hold snapshots and supplied reviewer roles.

steps.title: Resolve dated specimen evidence
steps.procedure: Classify actual result rows as active, superseded, pending-retest or future; never promote a pending replacement.

steps.title: Assess required evidence
steps.procedure: For each required test, compare active values and specimen counts; inspect certificates and open nonconformance records.

steps.title: Determine the review category
steps.procedure: Apply data-review, nonconformance-review, evidence-gap, complete precedence while preserving every reason.

steps.title: Assign evidence and review questions
steps.procedure: Emit explicit sorted source/lot exceptions and configured owner roles, including overdue review.

steps.title: Prioritize the QA queue
steps.procedure: Order all lots by category/age/ID and assign contiguous ranks without changing source inventory.

steps.title: Close the review preparation
steps.procedure: Write the complete review-only JSON envelope and reconcile received, known-held and per-category quantities.
